fitted_on.one_wave_or_more: sweep F (4096x8192xK, GEMM_TILE_LIMIT = 256 + S, S <= 128, K = 512-16384), every cell (version 1's constants); k_s on sweep F's 15 cells with S > 128
fitted_on.less_than_one_wave: sweep G (4096x8192xK, GEMM_TILE_LIMIT = S, S <= 128, K = 512-16384, and 32768 at S = 128), every cell; k_s on its cells with S > 128
fitted_on.spread_test: sweep H (4096x8192xK, S = 132-255, K = 2048-32768, GEMM_TILE_LIMIT = S and 256 + S, two rounds), every cell: spread if (256 - S) k >= C, per regime

regime: less_than_one_wave if tiles < num_programs, else one_wave_or_more

variants.one: the rule family as version 1, constants by regime
variants.one_sqrt: below one wave, the family with the reduce-scatter n also at most Q / sqrt(S); one wave or more as `one`
